title: EC-Council CSCU
summary: EC-Council CSCU is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 11 course modules: Introduction to Data Security, Securing Operating Systems, Malware and Antivirus, Internet Security, Security on Social Networking Sites, Securing Email Communications, Securing Mobile Devices, Securing the Cloud, Securing Network Connections, Data Backup and Disaster Recovery, Securing IoT Devices and Gaming Consoles. Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
objectives: Securing IoT Devices and Gaming Consoles
attributionNote: EC-Council certification content is an independent study guide written for Cyber Pulse Academy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EC-Council.
